tasks.title: Add shared verification scripts
acceptanceCriteria: A non-mutating Biome check and TypeScript check are available through package scripts.
TypeScript checking includes the Vercel API routes.
A single verify script runs tests with LCOV coverage, type-checking, and Biome checks.
Generated coverage output is ignored by Git.
Existing Codecov thresholds are not changed.

tasks.title: Use shared verification in CI and deployment
acceptanceCriteria: PR CI and release deployment invoke the same verification command.
Both workflows use frozen dependency installation.
Codecov upload remains required and the 1% project and patch thresholds remain.

tasks.title: Add PR dependency and secret scans
acceptanceCriteria: PR dependency review fails for newly introduced high or critical vulnerabilities in runtime, development, and unknown dependency scopes.
PR secret scanning fails when a secret is detected.
Existing daily Dependabot updates remain enabled.

tasks.title: Require validation and security checks on main
acceptanceCriteria: Main branch protection requires the verification, dependency-review, and secret-scan checks.
The configured required-check names exactly match the GitHub Actions check names.
The rule is verified through the GitHub API.
files: GitHub repository branch protection for main (configured through the GitHub API)

tasks.title: Add isolated health endpoint and tests
acceptanceCriteria: GET health response succeeds without initializing Telegram, Gemini, or Google Sheets integrations.
Unsupported methods are rejected.
Bun tests cover success and unsupported methods without live credentials or API calls.

tasks.title: Probe health after production deployment
acceptanceCriteria: The release workflow still deploys production only when a GitHub Release is published.
After deployment, the workflow requests VERCEL_PRODUCTION_URL/api/health.
A missing URL or unhealthy response fails the workflow.
No automatic rollback or preview deployment is added.

tasks.title: Document verification and deployment configuration
acceptanceCriteria: README explains local verification and required PR checks.
README documents VERCEL_PRODUCTION_URL as a public Actions variable and the post-deploy probe.
README preserves the existing release deployment and secret guidance.

tasks.title: Measure and optimize CI feedback safely
acceptanceCriteria: Post-change Actions duration is compared with the observed 8–18-second baseline.
Only measured-beneficial caching or superseded-run cancellation is retained.
No hard runtime SLA is introduced.

tasks.title: Validate the complete CI/CD contract
acceptanceCriteria: Bun tests, TypeScript, and Biome checks pass.
Workflow syntax and required check names are validated.
Branch protection and release health-check ordering/failure behavior are verified.
Any remaining maintainer-only configuration is reported.
